title: Lowell P. 'Pete' Beveridge Jr. marries Hortense 'Tee' Sie
description: In a firsthand oral history recorded in 2012, Pete recalls marrying Hortense ('Tee') Sie in JANUARY 1954 at St. Philip's Episcopal Church in Harlem while he was on Army leave. He says his parents and younger brother attended and his parents blessed the wedding, while his paternal aunts and uncles objected and had discouraged Tee visiting shared North Haven family property. The more sensational secondary claim of a 1953 wedding, complete parental banishment or exactly 20-year exile is not established by this source.
place: St. Philip's Episcopal Church, Harlem, New York
evidence_status: Confirmed as January 1954 by groom's 2012 oral history; exact day, original marriage certificate and 20-year exile unverified

title: Lowell Sr. reports sale of North Haven family farm in a Harvard class history
description: Lowell Pierson Beveridge Sr.'s entry in Harvard's 1960 class report says the family sold their North Haven Island farm during the preceding five years. The 1960 publication is not a deed; neither the exact sale date, parcel, buyer, nor an alleged connection to his son Pete's 1954 marriage is established by it.
evidence_status: Contemporary father-authored 1960 statement of earlier sale; exact property records and cause pending

title: Pete Beveridge gives a first-person oral history of the North Haven family and marriage
description: On May 23, 2012, Sady Sullivan recorded Lowell Pierson 'Pete' Beveridge Jr. discussing his childhood summers among extended relatives in North Haven, his studies and political activities, his marriage to filmmaker Hortense Sie, family opposition from several older relatives, and his parents' eventual support. The 34-page transcript is available at Brooklyn Historical Society with research-use restrictions; any biographical interpretation should accurately attribute disputed motives as Pete's own recollection.
evidence_status: First-person recording transcribed by the holding institution; notes distinguish narrator's memory from independently verified fact
